# Sanitized eRegister structural fixtures

These three HTML fixtures preserve the relevant table layouts observed in
`D:\tmsearch\Trade Marks - eRegister-3.html`, `ShowOppRecDetails.htm`, and
`Get_Opposition_Reminder_Correspound.htm`.

Names, addresses, identifiers, dates, and opaque link values have been replaced
with synthetic values. Original scripts, hidden inputs, images and session
tokens are excluded. Headers remain ordinary `td` cells where the saved portal
uses them; nested layout tables are retained to test row ownership.

The multiple-proceeding test is synthetic. It does not prove the live portal's
layout for rectification, decisions, or multiple proceedings. See
`deploy/PORTAL-SNAPSHOT-AUDIT.md` for verified formats and remaining questions.
